run_cfr_solver_kuhn_poker: run the CFR solver on Kuhn Poker game with configurable iterations and player count
create_cfr_solver: create a CFR solver instance for a specified game loaded via pyspiel.load_game
test_exploitability: test the exploitability of a CFR solver's average policy on a game
build_cfr_training_loop: build a training loop that iteratively evaluates and updates the CFR policy
summarize_cfr_example: summarize the CFR example script that trains on Kuhn Poker and prints exploitability
